title: First-Click Quickflows: Column-targeted micro-tutorials for Rollouts & Cost Insights
creator: Maya Alvarez
description:
Goal: Introduce a lightweight, contextual onboarding pattern that appears on a user’s first interaction with specific Console columns (e.g., Rollouts list, Cost Insights summary, Model Routes) to reduce time-to-first-success without overwhelming the workspace. Pattern = First-Click Quickflow: a transient, column-anchored micro-tutorial that surfaces 2–3 task-specific actions, a one-line outcome statement, and an inline CTA that launches a sandboxed template or guided edit.

Scope: Design microcopy, responsive layout for desktop and tablet, ARIA labels for screen readers, prototype flows for Figma interactive testing, and handoff tokens for implementation. Excludes mobile-specific variants (future work).

Acceptance criteria: (1) Prototype demonstrates flow for Rollouts column and Cost Insights column; (2) Copy written for three personas (New Developer, Platform Owner, CFO-analyst); (3) Accessibility checks: contrast, keyboard focus, screen reader text passes quick audit; (4) Developer-ready spec with interaction states, dismissal rules (temporary, persistent opt-out), telemetry hooks, and localization-ready strings.

Deliverables: Figma interactive screens (3 states per column), copy deck, accessibility checklist, implementation notes for interactions and telemetry, post-rollout success dashboard definition (time to first rollout, feature opt-outs, tutorial CTR).

Design constraints & trade-offs: We prioritize minimal visual weight to avoid disrupting power users. That means fewer steps in the flow and placeholders for deep-help links rather than full inline tutorials. Trade-off: less in-context teaching vs. lower cognitive load. Consider adding a delayed multi-step tour for users who opt into extended learning.

Success metrics: 20% reduction in time-to-first-rollout for new workspaces, 15% improvement in ‘view-to-action’ conversion in Cost Insights within 14 days, <2% assist-layer dismissal rate after 30 days.

Implementation notes: Anchor to column header cell; show only on first three visits for users with <5 API requests/day; record metrics: shown, clicked CTA, dismissed, persisted opt-out. For rollout CTA, prefer launching a lightweight template editor rather than a full new-page redirect.
